props.title: Inquiry received
props.description: We've received your inquiry. Someone from our team will get back to you with availability and a price.

props.html: Thanks for reaching out! We've got it from here.
One of us will reply with availability and costs, and we may have a question or two for you.

props._notes:
"Consider it started." is the page's wink (§6.4). The reply window
           came out 2026-08-18 per Daniel; it now lives on the contact page
           and in the booking-page steps table only.
